desc: Ideation: model the game as claim moves plus a common pass pile and identify parity as the likely invariant.
Prove the parity reduction: show p=0 and positive even pass piles are equivalent and reduce states to (unclaimed count, even-A count, pass parity).
Solve the reduced recurrence to justify the closed form with exceptions N=1,2,3 and odd_count parity for N>=4.
Implement the O(N) Python solution using the closed form and run sample tests.
Brute-force verify the closed form for small N and small A_i to catch edge cases.
Confirm O(N) time, O(1) extra memory, and stdout output.
